task.title: P6-141: Fix two silent failure paths in Pull: stale checklist lines and no-toast no-op
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Needs, shopping and pull). Original id: P6-141. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Two ways the pull path goes silent** (was `P6-049c` + `P6-049d`): a row-level Pull that closes a need while the pick list is open leaves those lines on the checklist, where they can only ever produce a `NoLongerNeeded` error toast (`needs.rs:335-338`, `:521-523` — the picks snapshot is deliberately outside the `Transition`); and a Pull whose items resolve to nothing raises **no toast at all** (`report` is a no-op on an empty outcome, `needs.rs:855-926`), a silent no-op rather than a refusal.
